name: Call Animals
description:
Concentration, up to 1 hour.

You issue a loud call — a whistle, shout, or resonant cry — summoning nearby non-humanoid creatures native to the current Biome.

Choose one creature of Challenge 4, or any number of creatures with a combined Challenge of 4 or less. The summoned creatures emerge from the nearest plausible hiding places and move toward you until they are within Medium Range.

The creatures are friendly to you and your allies. While within Medium Range, they obey your verbal commands. If given no commands, they defend themselves but otherwise take no action.

If summoned during combat, they roll Initiative as a single group when they appear.
